name: Sannohe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sannohe town emblem in orange and maroon: an orange broken ring enclosing three maroon horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Sannohe, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1977; the emblem dates from 20 March 1955.

features.role: Sannohe town emblem — an orange broken ring enclosing three maroon horizontal bars
